title: 第十三章 赶进度第十四章 时间紧任务重
slug: 穿进男频爽文反派师尊科学修仙
lines: 解清玄简单施法拾掇了一下自己，见仙府中景色不错，便拿来几本书，坐在院中树下借着晨曦参读起来。
当金色晨光驱散了山间晨雾之时，段莫弃收拾好行李，按照吩咐来到解清玄的仙府。
兴许师尊是在特意等候自己，仙府前院素雅的原漆木门敞开着，而一身银白道袍的他就盘坐在院内石岛正中，单手撑着本书，有些慵懒地靠着那颗茂密金桂树认真参读着。
微风卷下零星桂花，映着朝阳如金色星辰洒落在解清玄身上，为那冷清的身影镀上一层难得暖色。
树下之人如此柔和恬静的样子让段莫弃觉得很陌生。
大抵是看书看累了，那人伸了个懒腰，略带幽怨地抬头看了看日头，恰巧就瞥到了自己。段莫弃连忙收起疏忽流露的片刻异色，重新挂上那公式般的恭敬神情俯身行礼。
见解清玄无奈笑着摇了摇头抬手招呼自己过去，他才起身迈入院门。
‘这孩子，又是一副傻样的在门外干等。’解清玄摇摇头，‘来了也不知道吱一声提醒她！’若是自己没能瞥见他，难道他要在门口自行罚站到晚上吗？
“下次来了便自己知会一声，莫要傻站着。”解清玄招招手，示意段莫弃进门。
“是，师尊。”
段莫弃阔步入院，他身形挺拔，肩宽腰窄，看着比原主这男身壮上不少，身高应该有个一米九。他徐徐靠近席地而坐的解清玄时，还真让她感到了一些莫名的压迫感。仿佛他举止上的礼貌与客气已经有些压不住气质上流露出的丝丝戾气了。
“来，这边坐。”解清玄微笑着抬手，向身旁蒲团做了个“请”的手势。
段莫弃再次行礼后乖乖盘腿落座。
解清玄总算不用再昂着脖子与他说话，感觉好多了。
“小莫弃，时间紧迫，我也不与你兜圈子了。流云心经你现在练到几阶了？”
“回师尊，五阶，但并未能融会贯通。”
解清玄点点头，心下了然：“你天资聪慧又十分勤勉，差的应当只是半分点拨。你且先运气游走一遍五阶心法让为师看看。”
“是，师尊。”
解清玄尝试着使用并不能熟练控制的神识试图看清段莫弃的灵气游走。半小时后，她好像看到了问题所在，但又似乎并未能将问题看完整。
她好像还是需要使用“灵气注入”这种更直观的方法再去评测一番……
解清玄叹了口气，还是与段莫弃打了个招呼就向他丹田伸出了手。
一晚上的俗称备课没法改变一个人是文盲的事实。她这次是完整理解了【流云心经】的，但她的语言组织能力出了问题，许多经脉的固有名词她也没记住。所以若是不配合“身教”，仅凭她苍白的表达是无法准确点出段莫弃现有问题的。
这一次，面对解清玄伸过来的爪子，段莫弃神色无常，也十分坦然地接受了解清玄探进来的灵力。
反倒是解清玄这次稍稍有些走神……
段莫弃小腹处那外层柔软内里坚实，又凹凸有致的触感着实让她有些难以集中精神。
content_en:
Jie Qingxuan simply cast a spell to tidy himself up. Seeing that the scenery in the Immortal Mansion was nice, he took a few books and sat under the tree in the courtyard to read in the morning light.
When the golden morning light dispersed the morning fog in the mountains, Duan Moqi packed his luggage and came to Jie Qingxuan's fairy mansion as instructed.
Perhaps the master was specially waiting for him. The elegant original lacquered wooden door of the front yard of the Immortal Mansion was open, and he, dressed in a silver-white Taoist robe, was sitting cross-legged in the middle of the stone island in the yard, holding a book with one hand and lazily leaning on the dense golden osmanthus tree to read carefully.
The breeze swept down scattered osmanthus flowers, reflecting the morning sun and falling on Jie Qingxuan like golden stars, coating the deserted figure with a rare layer of warmth.
The gentle and peaceful look of the people under the tree made Duan Moqi feel strange.
Probably tired of reading, the man stretched his body, looked up at the sun with a hint of resentment, and happened to catch a glimpse of himself. Duan Moqi quickly put away his inadvertent expression, put on his formal respectful expression and bowed in salute.
Seeing that Qingxuan smiled helplessly, shook his head and raised his hand to greet him, he stood up and walked into the courtyard.
…
‘This kid is waiting outside the door looking stupid again. ’ Xie Qingxuan shook his head and said, ‘I didn’t know how to remind her when I came! ’ If I couldn’t catch a glimpse of him, would he have to stand at the door until night?
"Let me know when you come next time. Don't stand there stupidly." Xie Qingxuan waved to Duan Moqi to come in.
"Yes, Master."
Duan Moqi strode into the hospital. He was tall and tall, with broad shoulders and narrow waist. He looked much stronger than the original owner. He should be about 1.9 meters tall. When he slowly approached Xie Qingxuan, who was sitting on the floor, she really felt some inexplicable pressure. It was as if the politeness and politeness in his manner could no longer suppress the traces of hostility in his temperament.
"Come, sit here." Xie Qingxuan smiled and raised his hand, making a "please" gesture to the futon beside him.
Duan Moqi saluted again and sat down cross-legged obediently.
Xie Qingxuan finally no longer had to hold his neck high to talk to him, and felt much better.
"Xiao Moqi, time is running out, and I won't go around in circles with you. How many levels have you reached in the Liuyun Heart Sutra now?"
"Returning to Master, fifth level, but failed to comprehend it."
Xie Qingxuan nodded and understood: "You are talented, intelligent and very diligent, and the difference should be only half a point. You should first try your luck at the fifth-level mental method and let me have a look."
"Yes, Master."
Jie Qingxuan tried to use his spiritual consciousness, which he could not control skillfully, to try to see clearly Duan Moqi's spiritual energy movement. Half an hour later, she seemed to see the problem, but she didn't seem to be able to fully understand the problem.
It seems that she still needs to use the more intuitive method of "spiritual injection" to evaluate again...
Xie Qingxuan sighed, said hello to Duan Moqi and stretched out his hand to his Dantian.
A night of preparing lessons cannot change the fact that a person is illiterate. She fully understood the [Liuyun Heart Sutra] this time, but there was a problem with her language organization ability, and she could not remember many of the proper nouns of the meridians. Therefore, if she does not cooperate with "teaching by example", her pale expression alone will not be able to accurately point out Duan Moqi's existing problems.
This time, facing Xie Qingxuan's extended claw, Duan Moqi looked unsteady, and he accepted the spiritual power that Xie Qingxuan came in very calmly.
On the contrary, Xie Qingxuan was a little distracted this time...
The soft outer layer and firm inner surface of Duan Moqi's lower abdomen made it difficult for her to concentrate.
